notes.title: Patch #1, upcoming 18+ free DLC and importance of the reviews!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33183180/36eb8c3132fdcc912c056e5779500104ea693da3.png[/img]

Greetings, adventurers!

[h1]Patch #1 is out[/h1]

[b] Changelog:[/b] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug that would break History screen in the Good Ending
    [*]Changed the CG in the animated version of the Bonfire Lute CG in the gallery to a newer version
    [*]Added an "A" button as a shortcut for auto mode
    [*]Slime scene should now properly unlock in the gallery
[/list]

If you spot any bugs or typos, please make sure to put them here https://steamcommunity.com/app/879510/discussions/0/2656452469257570902/

We'll try our best to fix everything ASAP!


[h1]What's with that DLC?[/h1]

We got much feedback on how to treat adult content and finally made a decision to provide you guys and gals with a free 18+ DLC. It'll take some time to produce, but all in all, it's definitely happening. 

Let's hope we won't get any troubles with product visibility. We really hope Lucy Got Problems will do good and we'll be able to bring more various titles to life!


[h1]The reviews must flow![/h1]

If you have any thoughts on Lucy Got Problems, [b][u]please consider writing a review here on Steam.[/u][/b] 

[b] Why are Steam reviews important?[/b] 
[list]
    [*]They help Steam see our product's not fake and allow trading cards, profile BGs, and emoticons.
    [*]They keep us updated on your opinion and encourage us. 
    [*]They help other users decide if they're interested in what we've got.
[/list]

Even a couple sentences will do a great job, though we'd love to know the details!

Aaand that'll be it for the moment. 

Thank you so much for your attention and feedback!
Stay tuned for the further updates.
